## iRhythm Announces $100 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreement


11/17/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/296879096/files/doc_news/iRhythm-Announces-100-Million-Accelerated-Share-Repurchase-Agreement-2026.pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- iRhythm Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today announced that it has entered into an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association (JPMorgan) for $100 million of its common stock, as part of its previously announced $200 million share repurchase authorization.


Under the terms of the ASR, iRhythm will make an initial payment of $100 million to JPMorgan and receive an initial delivery of shares representing approximately 80% of the total number of shares expected to be repurchased under the ASR. The total number of shares that iRhythm will ultimately repurchase under the ASR will be determined based on the volume-weighted average price of the company's common stock during the term of the ASR, less a discount and subject to adjustments pursuant to the terms and conditions of the ASR agreement. Final settlement of the ASR is expected to occur no later than the first quarter of 2027. Following completion of the ASR, iRhythm will have approximately $100 million remaining available under its outstanding share repurchase authorization.


The company expects to fund this ASR with existing cash and cash equivalents.


**About iRhythm Holdings, Inc.**


iRhythm is a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease. Combining wearable biosensors and cloud-based data analytics with powerful proprietary algorithms, iRhythm distills data from millions of heartbeats into clinically actionable information. Through a relentless focus on patient care, iRhythm's vision is to deliver better data, better insights, and better health for all. For more information, visit[www.irhythmtech.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cRbdLMNfo45HQiJxaN2YVKplK2w8vd82c_2iwy0hJg8dC3H6GUVTZo-67xf37kTjeDlN2EjU4k8pSq-MwDHV3EdSx2uWY9fqdkb78Jw-SOU=) .
